author: Dhruba Poudel
creator: Dhruba Poudel

standalone_php.scope: Pure domain rules and WordPress/WooCommerce adapter doubles, including genuine no-Woo fallback child process.

public_php_endpoint.scope: Isolated actual PHP endpoint execution; four fixed scenarios, source immutability and bounded input/method.

interface.scope: Actual PHP fixture envelopes with simulated DOM/fetch; timeout, stale reply, filters, aligned inspector, error recovery and export.

theme_interactions.scope: Simulated DOM menu, Escape/focus, category filtering, disclosures and fixture controls.

real_wordpress_without_woocommerce.scope: Actual WordPress REST dispatch/capabilities/nonces/admin markup. Woo-specific group skipped because WooCommerce was absent.

real_wordpress_woocommerce.scope: Actual REST, exact fictional order reads, source equality, no order-write hooks and fixture cleanup.

real_theme.scope: 26 disposable products; hidden/search/draft exclusion, catalogue-only inclusion, stored and raw hostile-title escaping, real template/assets, no read/render mutations and cleanup.

browser.scope: Internal browser against local PHP and WordPress servers.
checks: Real local WordPress login and cookie/nonce admin POST rendered 14 baseline rows and the golden hash.
Four public PHP scenarios produced their expected counts.
Native browser JSON download contained 14 baseline rows and the golden hash.
Theme category filter returned one carry object and restored all six.
1280px desktop and 390px mobile had no page overflow.
Mobile Menu/Escape returned focus and collapsed navigation.

independent_review.status: All reproduced findings fixed and independently rechecked
repairs: JSON objects now rejected where arrays are required.
Public hung request now has a 15-second deadline and usable retry.
Filtering keeps inspector within the visible register.
Theme visibility filtering occurs before the product result limit.

test_correction: The real-theme stored-title assertion was corrected to compare visible DOM text with one entity decode of the actual WordPress-stored title. Strict no-script/no-event-handler checks and the unsaved full hostile-title probe remain unchanged.
environment_setup: WooCommerce tables and roles were explicitly installed in the disposable environment after activation. Initial missing-table/role setup errors were corrected before runtime checks; no production site was involved.
limits: Synthetic counts are not business savings or commercial accuracy.
Public PHP demo is separate from WordPress; theme link is a static preview.
No durable webhook ledger, order application or payment processing.
No exhaustive security/accessibility certification, production qualification, all database/HPOS combinations or WordPress.org directory approval.
